home.title: Pemby: jobs that can actually hire you
home.description: AI job-matching software. Pemby watches companies' own careers pages and tells you when a job appears that can hire you where you live. You apply yourself.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Pemby is free to start. Passes of 1, 3 or 6 months add instant matches and unlimited application kits. One-time payment, no auto-renew, 14-day refunds.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: The agreement between you and the company that runs Pemby, AI job-matching software where you apply yourself: passes, refunds, acceptable use and your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data Pemby collects, why, who handles it, how long we keep it, and how to export or delete it.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.description: Full refunds within 14 days of buying a Pemby pass. Passes are one-time payments that never renew, so there is nothing to cancel.
